findings.title: Wrong event listener removed in dispose
findings.body: The `dispose` method removes the `"message"` event listener bound to `this.onMessage` but leaves the `"close"` listener bound to `this.onClose` intact. The code that was removed targeted the wrong event (`"close"` instead of `"message"`), so the `"message"` listener remains attached and will fire after disposal, which can cause memory leaks or unexpected behavior.

summary.problem: The dispose method incorrectly removes the wrong event listener, leaving the message listener attached and risking memory leaks or unintended side effects.
summary.done_well: The change is minimal and targets the exact line that was wrong, making it easy to revert to the correct behavior.
